question: How do I know if I have a hidden leak?
answer:
Signs of a hidden leak include:
• Water meter running when all taps are off
• Unexpectedly high water bills
• Damp patches on walls, ceilings, or floors
• Musty smell
• Low water pressure

If you suspect a leak, call Rob on (000) 000-0000 — early detection saves significant damage and cost.

question: What should I do if I have a burst pipe?
answer:
1. Turn off your mains water supply immediately (usually at the water meter)
2. Turn off your hot water system
3. Call Rob on (000) 000-0000 — available 24/7

Do not delay — water damage escalates quickly.
